description: This file is a test class for the StreamingSessionActor in a Java Akka-based streaming system, specifically testing header interactions, response handling, and acknowledgment behaviors in different configurations.

classes.name: StreamingSessionActorHeaderInteractionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that parametrically tests the behavior of StreamingSessionActor regarding header interactions, timeouts, acknowledgements, and response handling.

classes.name: TestProbeForwarder
classes.description: An internal actor class used within tests to forward all messages to a provided TestProbe, facilitating message inspection during tests.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Provides all combinations of timeout durations, response required flags, requested acknowledgements, and success flags for parameterized testing.

methods.name: startActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes the static Akka ActorSystem before all tests run.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests have completed.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares mock behaviors before each test.

methods.name: stopActors
methods.description: Stops all created actor instances after each test.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the main test logic, sending messages to the StreamingSessionActor and asserting expected outcomes based on different configurations.

methods.name: createStreamingSessionActor
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of StreamingSessionActor with configured parameters for testing.

methods.name: getModifyThing
methods.description: Builds and returns a ModifyThing message based on current test parameters.

methods.name: getModifyThingResponse
methods.description: Generates a response for modify requests, success or failure, aligned with test expectations.

methods.name: getExpectedOutcome
methods.description: Calculates and returns the expected HTTP status code based on current test parameter configuration.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts the HttpStatusCode from a response message, handling different response types.
